{{Quote|What have we here?|Paak, upon discovering Zannah's double-bladed lightsaber|<ref name="rot" />}}
'''Bane's Heart''' was the name given to the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]], a name shared with [[Bane's Heart (crystal)|one]] of the two [[Synthetic lightsaber crystal/Legends|synthetic crystals]] used to [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|focus]] its blade. The [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed weapon]] was created to suit both [[Gender/Legends|her]] smaller figure and particular choice in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] style, [[Form III/Legends|Form III: Soresu]]. [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Zannah's lightsaber served her during the early [[Standard year/Legends|decades]] of the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|reformed]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and was instrumental in the defeat of many an opponent, including her own [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]], [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]]. The ancient [[Sith lightsaber/Legends|Sith lightsaber]] was rediscovered during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] by the infamous [[Jedi hunter/Legends|Jedi killer]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] and was later counted among the weapons of the prototype [[Battle droid/Legends|combat droid]] [[N-K Necrosis]].

==Description==
===Specifications===
{{Quote|The smaller blades give you greater speed and maneuverability&hellip; you will sacrifice reach and leverage, but you will be able to create a shield of impenetrable defense.|Darth Bane, to Zannah|<ref name="rot" />}}
[[File:Banes_Heart.jpg|thumb|left|100px|Bane's Heart lightsaber crystal]]
The [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] created a [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]] that was specifically designed to accommodate [[Gender/Legends|her]] slight physique. An elongated [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|hilt]] supported the [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-resonating,<ref name="doe" /> twin, [[Synthetic lightsaber crystal/Legends|synthetic lightsaber crystals]] that powered the weapon,<ref name="rot" /> one of which was [[Color/Legends|red]], starburst-shaped,<ref name="COF">{{SWGTCG|set=Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)|cardname=Bane's Heart}}</ref> and called [[Bane's Heart (crystal)|Bane's Heart]]. When in the possession of anyone other than its proper owner,<ref name="LOW" /> Zannah's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], which was also called Bane's Heart,<ref name="CSWE" /> released an electrical discharge courtesy of its specialized [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]].<ref name="LOW" /> The weapon produced twin red blades, each 0.75 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long. The lightsaber emitted a buzzing hum upon ignition and thrummed mildly when deactivated; it also emitted a peculiarly high-pitched sound when either blade absorbed or redirected [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. When not in use, Bane's Heart was worn at [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Zannah's hip, tucked inside her belt,<ref name="doe" /> or kept concealed within the folds of her [[Sith apparel|robes]], always on the left side for optimal accessibility to her preferential [[Limb/Legends|hand]].<ref name="rot" />

===Special handling===
{{Quote|Do not block. Redirect. Wait for opponents to become weary or frustrated. Let them make a mistake, then seize the opening and make them pay.|Darth Bane teaches Zannah how to utilize her weapon most effectively|<ref name="rot" />}}
The unique construction of the Bane's Heart lightsaber made a subtle yet critical difference from other lightsabers in the way it was wielded. The half-standard blade length resulted in reduced reach and leverage but granted a considerable increase in quickness and dexterity, a balance well-suited to the defensive nature of Zannah's chosen style of [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], [[Form III/Legends|Form III: Soresu]]. Although its creator was naturally left-handed,<ref name="rot" /> Bane's Heart could be wielded in either extremity. Zannah's defensive salute consisted of the lightsaber extended with the blades held horizontal to the ground.<ref name="doe" /> The weapon required precise wrist control and a light, but nonetheless firm, grasp to effect the twirling maneuver that constituted Zannah's wall of near-impenetrable defense. The hypnotic patterns woven by her ignited lightsaber served to unsettle unsuspecting opponents, who became increasingly frustrated as their attacks were repeatedly parried&mdash;instead of blocked&mdash;with minimal effort. When the enemy finally faltered, Bane's Heart allowed its wielder to retaliate with lethal speed, although the specialized length of the blades usually required close-quarter engagement to dispatch foes. Those of superior physical strength were only slightly hindered by the defensive style for which Bane's Heart was designed and were eventually able to disrupt the spinning lightsaber's momentum.<ref name="rot" />

==History==
===Zannah's weapon===
{{Quote|What is this? A lightsaber? Where'd you get this? You steal it off a Jedi or something?|Paak, to Zannah|<ref name="rot" />}}
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[996 BBY]] on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]], a young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|girl]] named Zannah constructed a double-bladed lightsaber as a test of her [[Sith training|apprenticeship]] under the ruling [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]]. Zannah was given two<ref name="rot" /> [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]<ref name="doe" /> synth-[[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] with which to power her weapon, one of which was called Bane's Heart, a name that was then shared with the apprentice's completed lightsaber. Initially reluctant to accept the defensive purpose of her saberstaff's unique creation, Zannah eventually mastered the creation of a nearly impenetrable defensive wall with her twin blades.<ref name="rot" />

[[File:2nd_Battle_of_Ambria.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Bane's Heart utilized in combat against a curved-hilt saber]]
[[990 BBY|Six years after]] its creation, Darth Zannah's lightsaber sparked the curiosity of [[Paak]], a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who had arrested her on the planet [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] for treachery against the [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] [[Anti-Republic Liberation Front]] (ARLF) organization. Confiscated from its owner, Bane's Heart was given to the ARLF's leader, [[Hetton]], whose interest piqued upon sight of the unique weapon. Zannah soon [[Telekinesis/Legends|retrieved]] the saberstaff and briefly dueled a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]]-armed Paak, whom she eventually [[Death/Legends|slew]] with a deflected [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Laser/Legends|bolt]]. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] apprentice was later forced to briefly wield her lightsaber [[Duel on Ambria (990 BBY)|against]] Darth Bane himself, who mistakenly believed that she had betrayed him before he was convinced otherwise.<ref name="rot" />

That same year, Zannah and her [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] were pursued by a strike team of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] world of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. The Sith were positioned in the [[Belia Darzu's fortress|abandoned fortress]] of the ancient Dark [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Belia Darzu]] when the Jedi arrived to do [[Duel on Tython|battle]], and Zannah ignited her double-bladed lightsaber [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|against]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Sarro Xaj]] and [[Johun Othone]]; the latter's awkward [[Form VI/Legends|Form VI: Niman]] technique offset his partner's more refined assaults. With Bane's Heart, Zannah was able to effortlessly deflect and redirect both men's incoming attacks, while the defensive shield she erected against them remained intact. Her saberstaff was minuscule in comparison to Xaj's blue-bladed version, and his superior strength with his own weapon was more than a match for hers when the two finally faced each other in single combat. Unable to rely solely on Bane's Heart for an ensured victory, Zannah [[Sith sorcery/Legends|conjured]] a [[Summon fear|Force distraction]] before she fatally slashed Xaj across his chest with her blades. The double-bladed lightsaber was then used to eliminate Jedi [[Raskta Lsu]] and Othone, both of whom were fatally [[Shiak|run through]] with its blades. When the Sith later returned to Ambria, Zannah murdered the planet's resident healer, [[Caleb]], with Bane's Heart, after she forced the reluctant man to heal her mortally wounded Master.<ref name="rot" />

[[980 BBY|Ten years later]], although Zannah had since become her Master's equal in strength and stature, she never gave him audience without being equipped with her lightsaber. While on a [[Mission to Doan|mission]] to the planet [[Doan]] on behalf of the Dark Lord, Zannah was compelled to kill two [[Sentience/Legends|beings]] with Bane's Heart, a [[Quano|Rodian]] and a [[Pommat|Human]], after it was determined that they had discovered the [[Sith sorcerer|Sith sorceress's]] [[Ciutric IV|planet of residence]]. Her venture led her to [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] and into [[Duel in Set Harth's mansion|direct confrontation]] with the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Set Harth]], whose specialized [[Form IV/Legends|Form IV: Ataru]] variant was no match for the instinctive defensive rhythm and impenetrable barrier created by Zannah's lightsaber.<ref name="doe" />

Zannah next employed her lightsaber against an unarmed Darth Bane, whom she had tracked to the [[Stone Prison]] of Doan and [[Duel on Doan|challenged]] for the mantle of Dark Lord of the Sith. Unfamiliar with the role of aggressor in lightsaber combat, Zannah uncertainly thrust her blades repeatedly at Bane and was forced to constantly block hurled bolts of Force lightning with either end. She was unable to defeat him even with the advantage of her saberstaff but was soon afterward granted another opportunity when Master and apprentice [[Duel on Ambria (980 BBY)|confronted]] each other for a final [[Time/Legends|time]] on Ambria. Despite the ferocity with which he attacked her, Zannah was able to remain grounded and safe behind her lightsaber's defensive shield for much of the duel. However, a misstep on her part resulted in the momentary loss of her weapon, and Zannah had to again rely on the Force to ultimately prevail against her opponent.<ref name="doe" />

===Recovery and later usage===
Centuries after Zannah created and owned Bane's Heart, the lightsaber came into the possession of a Dark Jedi who, by the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], lost it in a fatal encounter with [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], the [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies]] on either [[Dica]] or [[Necropolis (Core Worlds)|Necropolis]]. The saberstaff was one of the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] General's earliest lightsaber trophies, tokens that he kept from each additional Jedi death for which he was responsible. In the wake of Grievous's own [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|demise]] at the war's end, Bane's Heart was numbered among the collection of confiscated lightsabers he kept within his [[Soulless One/Legends|personal starfighter]]. It was soon afterward recovered by [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] of the [[New Order/Legends|newly formed]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and given to [[N-K Necrosis]], a prototype [[Battle droid/Legends|combat droid]] created from the reanimated corpse of the late General Grievous.<ref name="LOW" />

{{RPG}}
Around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] discovered and defeated N-K Necrosis in the [[Myyydril Caverns/Legends|Myyydril Caverns]] of the planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. The spacers looted the body of the destroyed [[Droid/Legends|droid]], taking as part of their spoils the Bane's Heart lightsaber crystal that once powered the eponymous lightsaber but had since been extracted from it.<ref name="Galaxies">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref>
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Zannah's lightsaber first appeared in the second novel of author [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s [[Star Wars: Darth Bane Trilogy|''Darth Bane Trilogy'']], titled [[Darth Bane: Rule of Two|''Rule of Two'']], and in its sequel, ''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]'', both of which give several pertinent details regarding the lightsaber's specifications. ''[[The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War]]'', an online article released through [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] as a supplement to the ''[[Unknown Soldier: The Story of General Grievous]]'' article, reveals N-K Necrosis's ownership of Bane's Heart, as well as Grievous's initial acquisition of the lightsaber from the unnamed Dark Jedi on either [[Necropolis (Core Worlds)|Necropolis]] or [[Dica]]. While ''Unknown Soldier'' never conclusively establishes the identity of the individual, [[Dark Jedi (comic story)|''Dark Jedi'']], a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] that falls within the non-[[canon]] elements of "[[Infinities]]," presents two possibilities in either of the [[Twin/Legends|twin]] sisters [[Kaa (Dark Jedi)|Kaa]] and [[Lii]], characters who fight Grievous on the worlds in question. ''The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War'' also reveals that the lightsaber was powered by a special crystal called Bane's Heart, a name that was later given to the lightsaber itself through its entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.
